issues.on_page: Capital contributions 65,789 + 6,956; Special items: Casualty loss income 772,515
issues.issue: Casualty loss income 772,515 is printed under SPECIAL ITEMS but was put in other_financing, while the other two special items (nonroutine maintenance -5,646, casualty loss expense -100,330) went to adjustments. Under the field rules special items are adjustments (or the insurance proceeds could be reimbursements/refunds). The arithmetic and roll-forward are correct either way (1,470,472 + 681,173 - 774,808 + 845,260 - 105,976 = 2,116,121).

Noncurrent compensated absences filed as accrued liabilities, which the rules define as items due soon; 'other liabilities' may fit better. Also, the labels for liabilities[3] and [6] have '(current)'/'(noncurrent)' added; both are printed simply as 'Compensated absences payable'.
